Frequently asked questions

Common questions about respond to a snap benefit reduction

Why would my SNAP benefits be reduced?

Common reasons include income changes, household composition changes, new deductions or shelters, or a recalculation during renewal. Your appeal should address the specific reason cited.

Can I keep my current SNAP amount during the appeal?

If you request a fair hearing within the deadline, you may be able to continue receiving your current benefit amount during the appeal process. Check your state's rules.
